name: Single Hero: A HoMM3 Fan Mod
description: One hero per player, like the Single Hero mode of Olden Era. Nobody can hire or free a second hero, and a player whose hero dies, retreats or surrenders is defeated, even with towns left. Works on hand-made scenarios and random maps.
author: Tihomir Ivanov (TishGamer)

0.1.0: One hero per player: the tavern and prisons cannot give anyone a second hero (also for the computer players)
Losing the hero (killed, retreated or surrendered) means defeat, even with towns left
The only hero cannot be dismissed

Works on hand-made scenarios and random maps: at the start every player keeps one hero (the hero a map objective needs, else the chosen starting hero, else the most experienced); a player with towns but no hero gets one in the main town
Own main menu: New Game, Multiplayer, Load Game, Credits, Quit
